title: Drugs and Lactation Database (LactMed)
organization: National Institute of Child Health and Human Development
versionLabel: Continuously updated database, 2006–; source-use snapshot reviewed July 26, 2026
citation: National Institute of Child Health and Human Development. Drugs and Lactation Database (LactMed) [Internet]. Bethesda (MD); 2006–. Source-use snapshot reviewed July 26, 2026.
populations: Breastfeeding patients and breastfed infants represented by source-scoped records
settings: Developer medication authoring and lactation evidence review

accessPolicy.licenseLabel: U.S. government-authored NLM database with item-level third-party caveats
accessPolicy.note: LactMed records can provide structured candidates for milk and infant levels, reported infant effects, effects on lactation, alternatives, record revision dates, and cited references. Government-authored record text is treated separately from copyrighted cited articles, images, trade names, and other third-party material. The database does not replace clinical judgment and cannot directly create a point rule.
